name: Masked Threshold
description: Port of FFmpeg's maskedthreshold filter: pick source or reference pixels by comparing their difference with a threshold.

inputs.name: reference
inputs.description: Reference clip (same size as the source)

params.name: planes
params.description: Bit mask of the channels to filter (1 = R, 2 = G, 4 = B, 8 = A); the others are copied from the first input

params.name: mode
params.description: 0 = abs (|source - reference| <= threshold keeps the source, else the reference), 1 = diff (reference - source <= threshold gives max(reference - threshold, 0), else the source)
